posts.title: Why Authorization is more important than ever
posts.description: Broken access control is at the top of the list for OWASP top 10. In fact, it’s still #1 in the 2025 release candidate with 100% (previously 94%) of tested applications showing some form of broken access control. That number alone should make you pay attention to the concept. Add to this the fact that we are now in an era where pretty much every developer is using Large Language Models (LLM) to so
